description:
Spring Boot orchestration platform.

        Responsibilities:
        - AgentPluginLoader: scans /agents/*.jar, loads via ServiceLoader
        - AgentLoopService:  drives Claude tool-use loop (the agentic engine)
        - AgentOrchestrator: routes chat messages to the loop
        - SchedulerService:  Quartz cron scheduling
        - ApprovalService:   HITL blocking, email/WS notifications
        - REST controllers:  /api/agents, /api/chat/*, /api/schedules, /api/approval
        - WebSocket STOMP:   /topic/agent-logs/{sessionId}
